digest.component_or_area: close landed-work precheck / commit reference resolver
propositions: The close landed-work precheck prints unrelated ambiguous-prefix resolver errors to stderr when scanning historical commit messages for ticket references.

The shared resolver resolve_ticket_id writes ambiguity diagnostics unconditionally to stderr for every candidate reference during history scans, even though the precheck only needs a boolean match result.

Adding a quiet keyword-only parameter to resolve_ticket_id gates the three stderr ambiguity prints, allowing the precheck to suppress diagnostics during internal history scans while preserving them for explicit user-supplied ambiguous prefixes.

The close precheck gate semantics and return values remain unchanged by suppressing ambiguity diagnostics; a full-ID trailer is still detected correctly when earlier history contains an ambiguous short prefix.
